areas.title: LLMs & agentic AI
areas.label: Primary focus
areas.summary: Multimodal reasoning, agent coordination, and verification in language and vision–language systems.
areas.motivation: How can language models and specialized agents share evidence and check one another without amplifying errors?
questions: How does unreliable intermediate information propagate across an agent workflow?
When does cross-agent verification improve the reliability of a final decision?

areas.title: Trustworthy & human-centered AI
areas.label: Connected area
areas.summary: Uncertainty, explanations, and appropriate human reliance on intelligent systems.
areas.motivation: A useful AI system should help people understand when to rely on its output and when to question it.
questions: How do confidence cues and explanations influence reliance on LLMs and VLMs?
How can adaptive interfaces respond to users while remaining understandable?

areas.title: Edge AI & intelligent sensing
areas.label: Connected area
areas.summary: Dependable learning under changing deployment conditions and limited resources.
areas.motivation: Models encounter changing environments, measurement noise, and resource constraints outside the laboratory.
questions: How should evaluation expose generalization failures under distribution shift?
How can sensing and state estimation adapt to changes in measurement quality?
directions: AI security and privacy in networked systems (broader interest)

areas.title: Federated learning & optimization
areas.label: Research interests
areas.summary: Distributed learning, optimization, and efficient adaptation, with interests in reinforcement learning and autonomous systems.
areas.motivation: How can learning and optimization support reliable decisions when data, computation, and feedback are distributed or constrained?
questions: How can federated learning balance privacy, communication cost, and generalization across heterogeneous data?
How can optimization and reinforcement learning support reliable adaptation and decision-making in autonomous systems?
directions: Optimization for reliable and efficient learning

ongoing.title: Multimodal agentic AI systems
ongoing.text: Developing a LangGraph-based framework in which specialized agents process multimodal evidence, exchange context, coordinate reasoning, and perform cross-agent verification. The study examines information sharing, intermediate failures, and error propagation.

ongoing.title: Trust calibration in LLMs and VLMs
ongoing.text: Investigating how model confidence, uncertainty, explanations, and high-confidence errors shape appropriate human reliance on language and multimodal AI.

ongoing.title: Multilingual prompting and tokenization
ongoing.text: Studying Bangla, Banglish, and English prompting across models to examine response quality, hallucination, confidence, and reliability.

ongoing.title: Reliable Edge AI under distribution shift
ongoing.text: Investigating robust evaluation and uncertainty-aware adaptation as sensing conditions, deployment environments, and input distributions change.

ongoing.title: Neuroadaptive AI from 32-channel EEG
ongoing.text: Co-investigator on a MIST research grant led by Dr. T. M. Shahriar Sazzad, developing a self-supervised Transformer pipeline for cognitive workload, vigilance, and affective-state modeling with interpretable closed-loop feedback.

ongoing.title: Explainable skin-lesion classification
ongoing.text: Developing a DINO-ViT framework on HAM10000 with uncertainty quantification, visual explanations, fairness analysis, and clinician-centered evaluation.

ongoing.title: Network decision support and adaptive estimation
ongoing.text: Studying AI-assisted decisions in simulated 5G networks and learning-assisted state estimation under time-varying sensing noise. These are ongoing investigations, with no completed findings claimed here.
